columns.name: RowId
columns.description: Contains the unique identifier for this sample
columns.caption: Row Id

columns.name: Name
columns.description:
Contains a short name for this sample.

If not provided, a unique name will be generated from the expression:
S-${genId}.
Example of name that will be generated from the current pattern: 
S-1001
columns.caption: Name

columns.name: Alias
columns.description: Contains the list of aliases for this data object
columns.caption: Alias

columns.name: Description
columns.description: Contains a description for this sample
columns.caption: Description

columns.name: SampleSet
columns.description: If this sample is a member of a sample type, contains a reference to the sample type
columns.caption: Sample Set

columns.name: MaterialExpDate
columns.description: The expiration date of the sample
columns.caption: Expiration Date

columns.name: Folder
columns.description: Contains a reference to the folder that holds this sample
columns.caption: Folder

columns.name: Run
columns.description: Contains a reference to the experiment run that created this sample, if available
columns.caption: Run

columns.name: LSID
columns.description: Contains a life sciences identifier for this sample
columns.caption: LSID

columns.name: IsAliquot
columns.description: Identifies if the material is a sample or an aliquot
columns.caption: Is Aliquot

columns.name: Created
columns.description: Contains the date and time that this sample was added to the system
columns.caption: Created

columns.name: CreatedBy
columns.description: Contains the user that created this sample
columns.caption: Created By

columns.name: Modified
columns.description: Contains the date and time that this sample last modified
columns.caption: Modified

columns.name: ModifiedBy
columns.description: Contains the user that last modified this sample
columns.caption: Modified By

columns.name: Flag
columns.description: Contains a reference to a user-editable comment about this row
columns.caption: Flag

columns.name: SampleState
columns.description: Represents the status of the sample
columns.caption: Status

columns.name: StoredAmount
columns.description: The amount of this sample currently on hand
columns.caption: Amount

columns.name: Units
columns.description: The units associated with the StoredAmount for this sample
columns.caption: Units

columns.name: RawAmount
columns.description: The amount of this sample currently on hand
columns.caption: Raw Amount

columns.name: RawUnits
columns.description: The units associated with the StoredAmount for this sample
columns.caption: Raw Units

columns.name: IsPlated
columns.description: Whether the sample that has been plated, if plating is supported.
columns.caption: Is Plated

columns.name: Properties
columns.description: Includes all properties set for this row
columns.caption: Properties

columns.name: Ancestors
columns.description: Contains the unique identifier for this sample
columns.caption: Ancestors
